title: Government's Actions after Disclosure in Panama Papers
what_it_is: Government's Actions after Disclosure in Panama Papers

sections.label: ACRA and MAS review Panama Papers
sections.summary: ACRA and MAS reviewed information released in May 2016 on individuals and entities named in the Panama Papers, including one Singapore-incorporated company.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) and the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) have been reviewing the information released in May 2016 on the individuals and entities named in the Panama Papers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Among the entities named, there was one Singapore-incorporated company.

sections.label: Authorities look into wrongdoing
sections.summary: Authorities look into whether any individual or entity in Singapore committed actual wrongdoing, and MAS and ACRA reminded FIs and CSPs to review customer relationships.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The approach taken by our authorities in connection with the Panama Papers, therefore, is to look into whether there was actual wrongdoing by any individual or entity in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: MAS and ACRA have reminded FIs and CSPs respectively of their duty to periodically review their customer relationships.

sections.label: MAS and ACRA compliance checks
sections.summary: MAS and ACRA are conducting checks that professional intermediaries under their supervision complied with obligations to prevent money laundering and terrorism financing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: MAS and ACRA are conducting checks to ensure that the professional intermediaries under their supervision have acted in compliance with their obligations to prevent money laundering and terrorism financing.

sections.label: Singapore regulatory regime and assistance
sections.summary: Singapore's regulatory and supervisory regime meets international standards and enables information exchange with overseas tax authorities, and Singapore stands ready to assist foreign investigations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Our regulatory and supervisory regime meets international standards and enables effective exchange of information with overseas tax authorities, including banking and trust information.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: To reiterate, Singapore stands ready to fully assist foreign authorities in their investigations into potential illicit activities, in accordance with our international commitments to global standards.

sections.label: Not naming individuals during investigations
sections.summary: It would not be appropriate to name individuals or entities during investigations because some may turn out to be in the clear.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Obviously, in the course of investigations, it would not be appropriate to name individuals or entities at this stage because some of them may well turn out to be in the clear.
